# x402-luhn-check

> Deterministic Luhn algorithm validate / check-digit for autonomous agents.

## Paid endpoint
- POST /api/luhn  (~0.004 USDC on Base)
  Body: { "action": "validate"|"checkdigit", "number": "..." }

## Free discovery
- GET /catalog
- GET /llms.txt (this file)

## Notes
- Fully no-human-in-loop
- Zero external dependencies
- Useful for card/IMEI/ID hygiene before downstream processing
